lesson: The system is consistently failing to distinguish between genuine trend reversals and liquidity sweeps, leading to premature entries during high-volatility chop. By prioritizing low-confidence setups (avg 43.5%) against the prevailing daily trend, the strategy is getting trapped in counter-trend traps rather than waiting for structural confirmation.
adjustment: Implement a mandatory 'Trend Filter' rule: only execute trades that align with the 4H EMA200 direction, ignoring all counter-trend SMC setups unless a confirmed Wyckoff Spring or Upthrust is present on the 4H timeframe.
methodology_flag: Trust lower-timeframe SMC liquidity sweeps less; prioritize higher-timeframe trend alignment.
